For every \(x\in\{1,\dots,242\}\), the pair \(\{x,243-x\}\) has sum \(243=3^5\), so \(T\) can contain at most one element from each such pair. These \(121\) disjoint pairs cover all \(242\) elements, so

\[
k\le 121.
\]

Now take \(T=\{1,3,5,\dots,241\}\), all odd numbers. The sum of any two elements of \(T\) is even, while every power of \(3\) is odd, so no forbidden sum occurs. Thus \(|T|=121\) is achievable.

\[
\boxed{121}
\]
